camel_example: aliyun sas GetLastOnceTaskInfo --region cn-hangzhou --TaskName ASSETS_COLLECTION --TaskType ASSETS_COLLECTION
description_en: Queries the running information of the latest scan task to determine whether the task is complete
description_zh: 查询最新一次扫描任务运行信息，判断任务是否扫描完成
kebab_example: aliyun sas get-last-once-task-info --task-type ASSETS_COLLECTION --task-name ASSETS_COLLECTION --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetLastOnceTaskInfo

ASSET_EXPOSURE_SCAN: asset exposure scan task
VUL_CHECK_TASK: vulnerability scanning task

CollectTime.description_en: The task running time. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
CollectTime.description_zh: 任务运行时间。采用 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the latest scan task

TaskInfo.description_en: The information about the latest task

Result.description_en:
The execution result of the scan task. Valid values:

SUCCESS: The scan task is executed.
TASK_NOT_SUPPORT_REGION: The image is in a region that does not support scanning.
TASK_NOT_EXISTS: The task does not exist
Result.description_zh:
扫描任务的执行结果。取值：

SUCCESS：扫描任务执行成功。
TASK_NOT_SUPPORT_REGION：镜像在不支持扫描的地域。
TASK_NOT_EXISTS：任务不存在

Status.description_en:
The running status of the task. Valid values:
INIT: Pending.
START: Started.
SUCCESS: Completed.
TIMEOUT: Timed out
Status.description_zh:
任务运行的状态。取值：

START：已启动
SUCCESS：已完成
